name: harden-milestone-observability-boundary
title: Harden ProofStory milestone status/ledger observability boundary (B-b550 M7 follow-up)
description: Implements the six design-hardening items the B-b550 truth-first audit recorded in the M7 follow-up scope of docs/requirements/decisions/milestone-ledger-status-review-findings.md. The milestone observability surface is safe today (no blocker); these tighten the boundary and close the audit's test gaps. Touches packages/main/src (milestone-status render + command-policy + proofstory) and packages/main/tests/smokes.

riskSignalsDismissed.reason: False positive: the story only MENTIONS production readiness inside disclaimer strings it adds (milestone_status/closeout output should explicitly state it is NOT production readiness). It does not touch production infrastructure, deployment, or any incident/hotfix path. This is a milestone-observability hardening story scoped to packages/main/src milestone-status/command-policy/proofstory and tests.
